name: Armored Keep

notes: Card prints 'You may play this card whenever you could play a tactic' where catalog uses the TACTICAL keyword (same meaning); 'when' vs catalog 'because'. No artist credit in footer.

name: Beatrix Winterbottom
subtitle: aggressive and dominant closer of deals
rules: UNIQUE BEATRIX -- If you draw any number of cards, increase the amount by 1. -- While you have at least 10 cards in your hand, if you would draw a card instead you don't draw that card.
flavor: She doesn't care about you, she's just looking at your assets.
printing: BETA ART (sketch art watermark); BETA set badge
notes: Card prints a replacement effect ('if you would draw a card instead you don't draw that card') at 10+ cards in hand; catalog says 'you cannot draw cards' (a prohibition). Also 'If you draw' vs catalog 'When you draw'. Likely same in practice but replacement vs prohibition could interact differently, so flagged. No artist credit in footer.

name: Limited Liability

flavor: "Alright, already. There's one for each arm, one for the head and one for the leg. But if you want a new shoehorn you'll have to buy it yourself. What do I look like? The charity department?"
printing: BETA ART (watermark over colored art); BETA set badge
notes: Card: no damage can be inflicted (prevented) and no cards can be destroyed, except as cost payment. Catalog: 'cards in play and cards deployed can only be destroyed by costs, and all inflicted damage is reduced to 0' (damage reduced rather than not inflicted; scope 'in play and deployed' vs all cards). Different mechanics/scope, so flagged. No artist credit in footer.

Never have the rich gotten richer with less effort."
